# The Indian Express

> India's leading digital news platform delivering breaking news, in-depth analysis, and multimedia coverage across politics, business, sports, entertainment and international affairs.

The Indian Express is a major Indian news organization with a comprehensive digital presence covering national and international news. The platform offers content in multiple Indian languages (Tamil, Bengali, Malayalam, Gujarati) alongside English, and provides specialized sections for UPSC exam preparation, premium journalism, and detailed explainers on current affairs.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Indian Politics
- Iran-Israel War
- Current Affairs
- UPSC Exam Preparation
- India News
- World News
- Regional News
- Delhi, Mumbai, Pune
- BJP
- West Asia
- Opinion & Analysis
- Live Updates
- City News
- Entertainment

## Breaking News & Headlines

- [Latest News Today](https://indianexpress.com): Homepage featuring breaking news and top headlines across India, entertainment, business, politics and sports.
- [India News](https://indianexpress.com/section/india): Breaking news and headlines from across India with coverage of Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and regional developments.
- [World News](https://indianexpress.com/section/world): International news covering Iran-Israel war, Middle East, US and global developments.
- [International News](https://indianexpress.com/international): Comprehensive world headlines, global developments and diplomatic coverage.

## Regional Language Portals

- [Tamil News](https://tamil.indianexpress.com): Tamil language news portal covering Tamil Nadu politics, elections, entertainment and regional news.
- [Bengali News](https://bengali.indianexpress.com): Bengali language news portal covering West Bengal politics, elections and Mamata Banerjee developments.
- [Malayalam News](https://malayalam.indianexpress.com): Malayalam language news portal covering Kerala news, politics, movies and regional developments.
- [Gujarati News](https://gujarati.indianexpress.com): Gujarati language news portal covering Gujarat and India news, politics, sports and breaking updates.

## News & Analysis Sections

- [Politics News & Analysis](https://indianexpress.com/politics): In-depth analysis of elections, government policy and political developments across India.
- [Explained: Current Affairs](https://indianexpress.com/section/explained): Breaking down news into clear, well-researched articles on current affairs and UPSC topics.
- [Opinion & Editorials](https://indianexpress.com/section/opinion): Editorials, expert columns and analysis on politics, economy and social issues.
- [City News](https://indianexpress.com/section/cities): Metro headlines, local news and municipal governance coverage from Indian cities.

## Lifestyle & Entertainment

- [Entertainment News](https://indianexpress.com/section/entertainment): Bollywood and Hollywood news, movie reviews and celebrity updates.
- [Sports News](https://indianexpress.com/section/sports): Cricket, football, hockey, chess and Indian athletes coverage with live scores.

## Learning & Preparation

- [UPSC Current Affairs](https://indianexpress.com/section/upsc-current-affairs): UPSC exam preparation content with daily current affairs, quiz and mains practice for aspirants.

## Premium & Print

- [Express Premium](https://indianexpress.com/about/express-premium): Subscriber content featuring long-form journalism, politics and international affairs.
- [ePaper](https://indianexpress.com/todays-paper): Daily ePaper PDF with headlines and city editions organized by sections.
- [Newsletters](https://indianexpress.com/newsletters): Daily newsletter subscription for news updates, reportage and in-depth analyses via email.
